items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Paul Dominguez. A brown skin fella. Paul Dominguez.

ctx.x: There's a guy named Robichaud, John Robichaud was a violin player. No, John Robichaud, no. A.J. P. Rohn, Peter Boccage. No, none of them.
Paul Dominguez. A brown skin fella. Paul Dominguez.
I can't think of any other more violin players offhand.
